title: Pictogram
look: A public sign: one white silhouette of rounded geometric parts, knocked out of a green plate.

doc.essence: The figure on a wayfinding sign: a single flat colour, no line, built from fat round-ended bars and circles so it reads from across a station.
doc.notIt: Not bauhaus (one colour only, rounded, a sign plate), not flat (no second colour, no shading, signage green), not line-art (filled, no line).
doc.shapes: No outline. Round corners, thick limbs of even width, round knob hands and block feet: every part reads as a simple geometric piece.
doc.colour: Every part is the same white; eyes, mouth and details are knocked out in the plate's green.
doc.eyes: Round dots punched out of the silhouette and a geometric mouth.
pitfalls: Parts that overlap merge into one shape: that is the point, but the face must stay inside the head.
Props in white on white parts disappear: they sit over the green plate.
